dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: The trailing edge exhibits a moderate concave curvature (falcate) starting from the apex and extending toward the posterior insertion point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded apex with a small pixel radius, forming a smooth transition between the leading and trailing edges.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: The leading edge presents a steep, primarily linear slope of approximately 45 degrees relative to the horizontal longitudinal axis of the body.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: The maximum pixel base width is approximately 1.5 times the maximum vertical pixel height measured from the dorsal ridge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of several small notches and irregular serrations along the trailing edge boundary of the dorsal fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Dense distribution of small, circular specular highlights consistent with water droplets across the entire visible lateral surface.
